```yaml
name: Lint and Typecheck

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # weekly at midnight UTC

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --only=dev
      
      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npx eslint .

  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run TypeScript check
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

  publish-dry-run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: typecheck
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run publish dry-run
        run: npm run publish-check

  dependabot-weekly:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
    steps:
      - name: Dependabot weekly update
        uses: dependabot/dependabot-core@v1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  npm-audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run npm audit
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high
        continue-on-error: true

  devcontainer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Build devcontainer
        run: docker build . -t knockout-tko-devcontainer
```
